summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel
details:
The SUSE Linux Enterprise 12 SP5 kernel was updated to fix various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2022-50645: EDAC/i10nm: fix refcount leak in pci_get_dev_wrapper() (bsc#1254633).
- CVE-2026-31663: xfrm: hold device only for the asynchronous decryption (bsc#1263133).
- CVE-2026-43428: USB: core: Limit the length of unkillable synchronous timeouts (bsc#1265138).
- CVE-2026-45834: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Fix null-ptr-deref in l2cap_sock_state_change_cb() (bsc#1266412).
- CVE-2026-45836: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Fix null-ptr-deref in l2cap_sock_get_sndtimeo_cb() (bsc#1266410).
- CVE-2026-46044: ipmi:ssif: Clean up kthread on errors (bsc#1267464).
- CVE-2026-46196: tracepoint: balance regfunc() on func_add() failure in tracepoint_add_func() (bsc#1266848).
- CVE-2026-46304: nvmet: avoid recursive nvmet-wq flush in nvmet_ctrl_free (bsc#1267985).
- CVE-2026-46312: media: videobuf2: Set vma_flags in vb2_dma_sg_mmap (bsc#1267990).
- CVE-2026-52975: bonding: 802.3ad replace MAC_ADDRESS_EQUAL with __agg_has_partner (bsc#1269234).
- CVE-2026-53037: HID: usbhid: fix deadlock in hid_post_reset() (bsc#1269081).
- CVE-2026-53237: gpio: mvebu: fix NULL pointer dereference in suspend/resume (bsc#1269131).
- CVE-2026-53284: btrfs: only release the dirty pages io tree after successful writes (bsc#1269816).
- CVE-2026-53385: vc_screen: fix null-ptr-deref in vcs_notifier() during concurrent vcs_write (bsc#1271834).
- CVE-2026-53400: i2c: core: fix adapter registration race (bsc#1273953).
- CVE-2026-63897: USB: serial: mct_u232: fix missing interrupt-in transfer sanity check (bsc#1272642).
- CVE-2026-63900: USB: serial: keyspan: fix missing indat transfer sanity check (bsc#1272499).
